universitaly_requirement.value: Applicants who require a study-entry visa must submit the official pre-enrolment application through Universitaly. The MUR procedures explicitly apply to 2026/27 and 2027/28. University validation does not guarantee a visa; universities may set their own earlier deadlines. This national rule is not a university-specific deadline.

current_cycle_evidence.relationship: Field-specific statements and their applicable route are manually checked; a detected year alone is not verification.

universitaly_requirement.covered_scope: Visa-requiring applicants; exceptions and residence-permit conditions follow the national procedure.
